items.raw_excerpt: The cost of fixing storm damage inflicted on Whangārei district roads earlier this year has risen to more than $23 million - of which almost $11m has been spent clearing one giant landslide.
items.summary_en: Fixing storm damage on roads in the Whangarei district now costs more than $23 million. Almost $11 million of that was spent to clear one big landslide. The storms hit the roads earlier this year.

items.raw_excerpt: A woman was escorted off a Batik Air flight at Singapore's Changi Airport after refusing to hand a large cardboard box to cabin crew, delaying departure by about an hour.
items.summary_en: A woman was escorted off a Batik Air flight at Singapore's Changi Airport. She refused to hand a large cardboard box to the cabin crew. The dispute delayed the flight by about one hour.

items.raw_excerpt: Odisha promises ₹11 lakh per player and ₹5.5 lakh per support staff after India's historic women's hockey Asian Games gold in 2026.
items.summary_en: Odisha state will give 11 lakh rupees to each player of the women's hockey team. Support staff will get 5.5 lakh rupees each. The reward comes after the team won gold at the 2026 Asian Games.

items.raw_excerpt: Australia and captain David Fifita have routed Papua New Guinea in the annual Prime Minister's XIII game in Port Moresby, while winger Jada Taylor has put her hand up for a World Cup berth after the women's team handed PNG a record loss.
items.summary_en: Australia beat Papua New Guinea in the annual Prime Minister's XIII rugby league match in Port Moresby. The Australian women's team also handed PNG a record loss. Winger Jada Taylor hopes her play earns a World Cup spot.
items.summary_ko: 호주가 포트모르비에서 열린 연례 총리 13인 럭비리그 경기에서 파푸아뉴기니를 대파했다. 호주 여자 대표팀도 뉴기니에 최다 점차 승리를 거뒀다. 윙어 제이더 테일러는 이 활약으로 월드컵 출전 자리를 노린다.

items.title_original: David Fifita leads Australia in wild mismatch against PNG

items.raw_excerpt: Researchers from the University of Cambridge have found 2.65 million small, newly growing trees in Cairngorms National Park, the result of a partnership of land managers committing to a 200-year environmental project.
items.summary_en: Researchers from the University of Cambridge found 2.65 million small, new trees in Cairngorms National Park in Scotland. The trees are growing thanks to a 200-year environmental project led by local land managers.

items.raw_excerpt: Retired DGP R. Sreelekha resigns as BJP councillor in Thiruvananthapuram Corporation, citing personal inconveniences and ongoing discussions.
items.summary_en: Retired police chief R. Sreelekha has quit as a councillor in Thiruvananthapuram Corporation. She said personal reasons and ongoing talks led to her decision.

items.summary_en: Italian translator Silvia Pozzi won a Pisa Book Translation Award. She translated the Taiwan novel Ghost Town by author Kevin Chen.

items.raw_excerpt: BJP seeks review of FIRs over Form 7 objections in Karnataka, demanding neutral police action and strict adherence to law.
items.summary_en: A former chief minister of Karnataka asked police to stop filing cases against BJP leaders. He also asked them to review cases that came from voter list objections. He said the police must act fairly and follow the law.

items.title_en: Former Karnataka chief minister urges police to stop filing cases against BJP leaders

items.raw_excerpt: Our column Inside Denmark takes a closer look at the stories we’ve been talking about over the last seven days. This week, editor Becky Waterton reflects on the bright side of the dark season in Denmark.
items.summary_en: This week's Inside Denmark column looks back at the stories of the past seven days. Editor Becky Waterton writes about the bright side of Denmark's dark season, and why she is looking forward to winter.

items.raw_excerpt: State-owned oil supplier CPC Corp., Taiwan, announced Saturday that it will keep its domestic gasoline and diesel prices steady next week as international crude oil prices still hovered at high levels.
items.summary_en: CPC Corp., Taiwan says gasoline and diesel prices will stay the same next week. The state oil company says international crude prices are still high. Drivers in Taiwan will not pay more at the pump.

items.raw_excerpt: Authorities in the Chinese city of Nanjing have removed a kindergarten principal and disciplined 11 officials after a former teacher reported that cooks washed mops and drain covers in the wok used for children's meals.
items.summary_en: A former teacher in Nanjing, China reported that cooks washed mops and drain covers in the wok used to make children's meals. Authorities removed the kindergarten principal and disciplined 11 officials.
